blocks.label: Living and Flaming Catastrophes
blocks.content:
Start: October 16, 2023 04:00:00 AM
End: October 30, 2023 04:00:00 AM When the same ally acts consecutively, they receive 1 stack of Memory Imprint. When allies with Memory Imprint attack, every Memory Imprint stack has a 40% fixed chance to inflict the target with Dissociation that lasts for 1 turn. Allies with Memory Imprint deal 40% more DMG. This effect cannot be stacked. When a different ally acts, remove all Memory Imprint stacks on the field.
Dissociation: This state is considered as the Freeze state. Affected units cannot take action. When this state is removed, the affected target receives Additional Ice DMG equal to 15% of their respective Max HP.[Note 1]

blocks.label: Ambrosial Arbor's Arrival
blocks.content:
Start: October 30, 2023 04:00:00 AM
End: November 13, 2023 04:00:00 AM At the start of every Wave or Cycle, apply Memory Imprint to an enemy target of elite level or higher. When targets with Memory Imprint receive DMG, other enemy targets receive DMG equal to 30% of the original DMG. This effect lasts until the start of the next Cycle.

blocks.label: Divine Root Subdual
blocks.content:
Start: November 13, 2023 04:00:00 AM
End: November 27, 2023 04:00:00 AM After a character unleashes an Ultimate or a follow-up attack, deals to the attacked enemy target Additional DMG of a random Type equal to 60% of the attackng character's ATK for 4 times.

Start: December 11, 2023 04:00:00 AM
End: December 27, 2023 04:00:00 AM When an ally uses their Ultimate, obtain Memory Imprint. This effect stacks up to 10 time(s). At the start of every Cycle, regenerate Energy to all allies based on the number of Memory Imprint stacks (Each stack regenerates 10 Energy). Energy obtained in this way can exceed allies' Max Energy.

blocks.label: Enigma in Deep Space
blocks.content:
Start: December 27, 2023 04:00:00 AM
End: February 05, 2024 04:00:00 AM After an ally Breaks enemies' Weaknesses or attacks Weakness Broken enemies, add 1 Hit(s) Per Action to Memory Turbulence, up to 10 extra hits.
At the start of every Cycle, every hit will deal DMG based on the enemy targets' respective Max HP[Note 1] to random enemy targets 1 time.

blocks.label: Light of Reignition
blocks.content:
Start: January 22, 2024 04:00:00 AM
End: March 04, 2024 04:00:00 AM At the start of every wave or Cycle, randomly applies a debuff for 10 time(s), selected from the following: reduce ATK by 8%, reduce DEF by 8%, reduce SPD by 8%, reduce Effect RES by 8%, or increase the received follow-up attack DMG by 20%. Each debuff can stack up to 3 time(s) and lasts for 3 turn(s). At the same time, enables 1 ally following either the Path of The Hunt or Path of Destruction to immediately take action.

blocks.content:

blocks.label: Eve of Wanton Feast
blocks.content:
Start: March 18, 2024 04:00:00 AM
End: April 29, 2024 03:59:00 AM Summons a Trotter at the beginning of each wave or each cycle. The Trotter takes 200% increased DMG from Basic ATKs and DoT effects.
When the Trotter is defeated, if any enemies are in Bleed, Shock, Burn, or Wind Shear state, immediately deals DMG equal to 50% of the original DoT effect to them, with a high chance to inflict Bleed, Shock, Burn, or Wind Shear on all enemies for 3 turn(s).

Word Shatter
When allies use their Ultimate to attack an enemy target, inflicts the target with Shatter, stacking up to 6 time(s). At the start of the target's turn or when the target is defeated, deals a set amount of DMG to the target and adjacent targets based on the number of Shatter stacks.

When allies use an Ultimate to attack enemy targets, additionally inflicts 1 stack of Shatter to the target.
 Excitation

When enemies enter battle, there is a 80% chance to instantly receive 1 stack of Shatter.
 Rupture

When enemy targets with Shatter are defeated, increases Ultimate DMG for all allies in this battle by 15%, stacking up to 20 times.

blocks.label: Effect
blocks.content:
Devious Flattery
Accumulate the amount of DMG dealt by allies' follow-up attacks. When this DMG amount reaches 100%, deal a set amount of DMG to all enemies.

Whimsicality no longer requires accumulated DMG from follow-up attacks. Instead, the effect's DMG Boost is increased by 60% after every time an ally launches 3 follow-up attack(s).

When the Whimsicality effect is triggered, regenerates Energy for all allies equal to 35% of their respective Max Energy. Energy recovered via this effect can exceed the ally's Max Energy.
 Reductio ad Absurdum

Apart from follow-up attacks, all other kinds of DMG dealt by allies can also accumulate progress equal to 18% of the original DMG amount.

blocks.label: Effect
blocks.content:
Skill Attack

After allies use Skill to attack enemy targets, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 5 Grit Value for allies.
 Concordant Truce

At the start of battle, after an ally uses their Skill to attack an enemy target, deals a set amount of DMG to all attacked enemy targets.
 Surging Grit

Upon entering Surging Grit, advances all allies actions by 100% and increases DMG received by enemy targets during this period by 50%. Additionally, after an ally uses their Skill to attack an enemy target, deals an additional set amount of DMG to all attacked enemy targets and adjacent targets.

blocks.label: Cacophony
blocks.content:
Empty Air

During Surging Grit, all ally Skills do not consume Skill Points. After characters use Skills or Ultimate, they gain 1 stack of "Feverish Surge" for every enemy target hit. These stacks will increase said characters' Skill and Ultimate DMG by 4% and SPD by 4% to a max of 10 stack(s).

After allies use Ultimate to attack enemy targets, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.
 False Promises

During Surging Grit, increases all allies' Follow-up ATK DMG by 40%. After triggering a Follow-up ATK, deals a set amount of DMG to every attacked enemy target and adjacent target.

After allies launch a Follow-Up ATK, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 2 Grit Value for allies.
 Hollow Hope

During Surging Grit, increases Break DMG received by enemy targets by 30%. When characters Break enemy targets' Weaknesses, advances the character's action by 12%.

After allies attack enemy targets, every enemy target that becomes Weakness Broken additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.

blocks.content:
Ultimate/Basic ATK

After an ally uses Basic ATK or Ultimate to attack enemy targets, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.

When allies use their Basic ATK or Ultimate to attack any enemy targets, inflicts the target with "Shatter," stacking up to 3 time(s). At the start of the target's turn or when the target is defeated by any unit, deals True DMG to the target based on the number of "Shatter" stacks.

When enemy target's Weakness is Broken, additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.
 Sanity

During Surging Grit, when any character uses their Skill, consumes HP equal to 20% of their current HP. Additionally, after using Skill, restores HP equal to 20% of their Max HP.

Each time any ally character receives an attack or loses HP, allies will additionally accumulate 2 Grit Value.

blocks.content:
Skill Attack

After allies use Skill to attack enemy targets, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 5 Grit Value for allies.
 Concordant Truce

At the start of battle, after an ally uses their Skill to attack an enemy target, deals a set amount of DMG to all attacked enemy targets.

blocks.label: Cacophony
blocks.content:
Empty Air

During Surging Grit, all ally Skills do not consume Skill Points. After characters use Skills or Ultimate, they gain 1 stack of "Feverish Surge" for every enemy target hit. These stacks will increase said characters' Skill and Ultimate DMG by 4% and SPD by 4% to a max of 10 stack(s).

After allies use Ultimate to attack enemy targets, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.

During Surging Grit, when any ally uses their Skill, consumes HP equal to 20% of their Max HP. Then, after using Skill, restores HP equal to 20% of their Max HP.

Each time any ally character receives an attack or loses HP, allies will additionally accumulate 3 Grit Value.

During Surging Grit, increases Break DMG received by enemy targets by 30%. When characters Break enemy targets' Weaknesses, advances the character's action by 12%.

After allies attack enemy targets, every enemy target that becomes Weakness Broken additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.

After allies attack enemy targets, every enemy target that becomes Weakness Broken additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.

blocks.label: Effect
blocks.content:
Triggers DoT

Every time a DoT is received by an enemy target, additionally accumulates 2 Grit Value for allies.
 Concordant Truce

When an enemy target enters battle, they are inflicted with 1 stack(s) of "Echo Enigma," which deals a special kind of Wind Shear, and they suffer 1 stack(s) of "Echo Enigma" after acting, receiving Wind DoT at the start of each turn. Goes up to 10 stack(s) at max for 3 turn(s).
 Surging Grit

Entering the "Surging Grit" state causes all enemies to suffer 5 stack(s) of the special Wind Shear "Echo Enigma," and causes all currently suffered DoT to immediately produce DMG equal to 100% of the original DMG. During the "Surging Grit" period, increases enemy targets' DMG received by 50%, reduces DMG dealt by 35%, and increases SPD by 50%.

blocks.label: Cacophony
blocks.content:
Exposition

During the "Surging Grit" period, the ally targets' DoT dealt ignores 20% of the target's All-Type RES. When the enemy target receives DoT, increases all allies DoT dealt by 1%. Up to a max of 99 stack(s). Lasts until "Surging Grit" ends.
 Intertextuality

During Surging Grit, Skill DMG dealt by ally targets increases by 50%. When attacking targets with the special Wind Shear "Echo Enigma," each stack of "Echo Enigma" additionally increases Skill DMG by 10%.

Every enemy target hit with ally targets' Skills additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.
 Misplacement

Every stack of "Echo Enigma" increases enemy target's DMG received by 3%. During the Surging Grit period, when enemy targets enter combat, and after they take action, additionally adds 1 stack(s) of the special Wind Shear "Echo Enigma."

After enemy targets are defeated, additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.

blocks.label: Effect
blocks.content:
Triggers DoT

Every time a DoT is received by an enemy target, additionally accumulates 2 Grit Value for allies.
 Concordant Truce

When an enemy target enters battle, they are inflicted with 1 stack(s) of "Echo Enigma," which deals a special kind of Wind Shear, and they suffer 1 stack(s) of "Echo Enigma" after acting, receiving Wind DoT at the start of each turn. Goes up to 10 stack(s) at max for 3 turn(s).
 Surging Grit

Entering the "Surging Grit" state causes all enemies to suffer 5 stack(s) of the special Wind Shear "Echo Enigma," and causes all currently suffered DoT to immediately produce DMG equal to 100% of the original DMG. During the "Surging Grit" period, increases enemy targets' DMG received by 50%, reduces DMG dealt by 35%, and increases SPD by 50%.

blocks.label: Cacophony
blocks.content:
Exposition

During the "Surging Grit" period, the ally targets' DoT dealt ignores 20% of the target's All-Type RES. When the enemy target receives DoT, increases all allies DoT dealt by 1%. Up to a max of 99 stack(s). Lasts until "Surging Grit" ends.
 Torn Fabric

During "Surging Grit," each stack of "Echo Enigma" increases Weakness Break Efficiency by 10% when ally targets deal damage.

When enemy target's Weakness is Broken, additionally accumulates 5 Grit Value for allies.
 Cinnabar Inscription

Every stack of "Echo Enigma" increases enemy target's DMG received by 3%. During "Surging Grit," enemy targets gain 1 stack(s) of "Echo Enigma" after a memosprite attacks them.

After memosprites' attacks, every enemy target hit additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.

This stage has a special Elation Skill.[Note 1] When entering Aha Instant, deals 15 instance(s) of Imaginary Elation DMG to a random enemy target. When an enemy target is defeated by any target, obtains 1 Punchline point(s).
 Surging Grit

Upon entering "Surging Grit," Aha immediately gains an extra turn where a fixed amount of 20 Punchline is taken into account. During this turn, Punchline is not consumed, and Elation Skill DMG dealt is 50% of the original DMG. During "Surging Grit," DMG taken by enemy targets increases by 50%, and Aha Instant's SPD increases by 40.

blocks.label: Cacophony
blocks.content:
Euphoria

During "Surging Grit," enemy targets take 30% more Elation DMG, and additionally increases Aha Instant's SPD by 20.
 Delirium

After an ally target uses their Basic ATK or Skill, gains 1 Punchline. During Surging Grit, the ally targets' DMG dealt increases by 50%.

For each enemy target hit with Basic ATK or Skill, ally team additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value.
 Improvisation

During Surging Grit, DoT taken by enemy targets increases by 50%. When an enemy target is defeated, allies gain 1 Punchline for each DoT effect this target is afflicted with.

Every time a DoT is received by an enemy target, additionally accumulates 1 Grit Value for allies.

blocks.label: Effect
blocks.content:
Debuff Application

When an ally target inflicts a debuff on an enemy target, allies additionally accumulate 1 Grit Value. This effect can be triggered up to 10 time(s) per enemy target.
 Concordant Truce

Decreases enemy targets' Effect RES by 30%. Increases DMG taken by enemy targets afflicted with 4 or more debuffs by 20%.
 Surging Grit

Upon entering "Surging Grit," deals a set amount of DMG to enemy targets 1 time for every debuff they are inflicted with. During "Surging Grit," DMG received by enemy targets increases by 50%. After each time an enemy target is inflicted with a debuff, inflicts 1 stack of "Dejection" on them, decreasing their All-Type RES by 1% for 2 turn(s). This effect can stack up to 20 time(s).

blocks.label: Cacophony
blocks.content:
Toccata

Increases Ultimate and Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by ally targets by 40%. During "Surging Grit," each time an enemy target is inflicted with the "Dejection" effect, it changes to stacking 2 stack(s) of this effect instead. The max stacking limit of the "Dejection" effect increases to 50 stacks.

Every enemy target hit with ally targets' Ultimate or Follow-Up ATK additionally accumulates 1 Grit Value for allies.
 Mirthful Cadence

After an ally character uses an Elation Skill to attack an enemy target, inflicts the "Indulgence" effect on the attacked enemy target, increasing the DMG taken by this target by 15% for 2 turn(s). This effect applied by each character exists independently. Upon entering "Surging Grit", allies gain 40 Punchline(s).

After ally targets use Basic ATK or Skill, for each enemy target hit, additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.
 Variation

After an ally target uses a Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate to attack an enemy target, there is a 100% base chance to reduce the attacked enemy target's DEF by 3%, lasting for 2 turn(s). This effect can stack up to 10 times.

Each time after ally targets use an attack, additionally accumulates 2 Grit Value for allies.
